title: Yelp vs Google Business Profile: Which Platform Matters More

facts.fact: Google Business Profile is a free tool provided by Google for managing a business's presence across Google Search and Maps.
facts.quote: Google Business Profile is a free tool provided by Google that lets businesses manage their online presence across Google Search and Maps.

facts.fact: Google processes billions of searches per day across all categories, according to the page.
facts.quote: Google processes billions of searches per day across all categories; Yelp's monthly unique visitors are reported in the tens of millions.

facts.fact: Yelp's monthly unique visitors are reported in the tens of millions, though the page does not name the source.
facts.quote: Yelp's monthly unique visitors are reported in the tens of millions.

facts.fact: The article was published on May 6, 2026.
facts.quote: Published Time: 2026-05-06

facts.fact: Google Business Profile's category system lets a business select one primary category and up to nine secondary categories.
facts.quote: you can select a primary category and up to nine secondary categories, which helps you appear in searches for related services.

facts.fact: Google has explicit policies against soliciting reviews in exchange for compensation or in bulk.
facts.quote: Google has explicit policies against soliciting reviews in exchange for compensation or in bulk

facts.fact: The article states that for most businesses outside food and personal services, customers' first touchpoint is often a Google search rather than Yelp.
facts.quote: For most businesses outside of food and personal services, Google is where customers start their search.

facts.fact: Yelp's review guidelines explicitly prohibit offering incentives in exchange for reviews.
facts.quote: explicitly prohibit offering incentives in exchange for reviews

facts.fact: The page states that a sudden spike in reviews, particularly after a marketing campaign, can trigger review filtering on Yelp.
facts.quote: A sudden spike in reviews, particularly following a marketing campaign, can trigger review filtering on Yelp.

facts.fact: The page describes a Google Business Profile listing as free, while Google's advertising products on it are paid.
facts.quote: GBP itself is a free listing

facts.fact: Google Local Search Ads are charged per click.
facts.quote: You pay per click

facts.fact: Yelp Ads operate on an auction model similar to Google Ads.
facts.quote: Yelp Ads operate on an auction model similar to Google Ads

facts.fact: The page states that Yelp has minimum ad spend requirements that change over time, without listing their amounts.
facts.quote: Yelp's minimum ad spend requirements and auction dynamics change

facts.fact: The page states that neither Google nor Yelp publishes advertising pricing that applies universally.
facts.quote: Neither platform publishes specific advertising pricing that is universally applicable.

facts.fact: The page recommends comparing GBP Insights and Yelp analytics over the same 30-day period.
facts.quote: Pull your GBP Insights and Yelp analytics for the same 30-day period

facts.fact: The page recommends asking 10 recent customers how they found the business.
facts.quote: Ask 10 recent customers how they found you.

facts.fact: The page recommends revisiting platform allocation decisions quarterly.
facts.quote: Revisit your allocation decision quarterly

facts.fact: The page recommends a quarterly review of platform performance before adjusting budget, bidding, or creative.
facts.quote: Schedule a quarterly review of your platform performance before adjusting budget, bidding, or creative.

facts.fact: The page's platform evaluation checklist includes uploading at least 10 photos to the Google Business Profile.
facts.quote: I have uploaded at least 10 photos to my GBP profile

facts.fact: The page's platform evaluation checklist includes responding to Google Business Profile reviews consistently within 48 hours.
facts.quote: I am responding to GBP reviews consistently within 48 hours

facts.fact: Google Business Profile itself is a free listing, while Local Search Ads on Google are a separate paid product managed through a Google Ads account.
facts.quote: GBP itself is a free listing, but Google offers Local Search Ads that appear above the local pack and within Maps.

facts.fact: Google Local Search Ads run on the same auction system as Google search ads and are managed through the Google Ads account.
facts.quote: These ads are managed through your Google Ads account and operate on the same auction system as search ads.

facts.fact: According to the source, there is no standalone 'GBP ad' product separate from Google Ads.
facts.quote: There is no standalone "GBP ad" product separate from Google Ads.

facts.fact: The source states Yelp's algorithm detects suspicious review patterns, so bulk review solicitation is discouraged on Yelp.
facts.quote: Yelp's algorithm detects suspicious review patterns.

facts.fact: The Google Business Profile Help article 'Read and reply to reviews' was reviewed on 2026-05-10 according to the page's source list.
facts.quote: Read and reply to reviews, [Read and reply to reviews](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3474122), reviewed 2026-05-10.

facts.fact: The Google Business Profile Help article 'Improve your local ranking' was reviewed on 2026-05-10 according to the page's source list.
facts.quote: Improve your local ranking, [Improve your local ranking](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7091), reviewed 2026-05-10.
